objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix assigned to the document (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: System-assigned sequential number appended to the document abbreviation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented upon each new editing/release cycle.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 3 years) defining how long a document remains valid after release.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 10 years) defining how long an archived document is retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) defining the applicability or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document via its properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational units for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Specific areas or regions where the document applies.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category that defines the level and kind of a document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction), determining templates, abbreviation, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document type.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid to which this type belongs.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation used in document numbering for this type.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period of extended validity configured for documents of this type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archive duration configured for documents of this type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document template.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document appended to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and follows the release cycle of the main document. Creation, modification, or archiving triggers a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be released directly via property switches. Its creation, modification, or deletion does not affect the main document version.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or title of the additional information object.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information has been released and published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for change to an existing released document that can be created by any author without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the proposed change to the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the validity extension must be processed.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity, triggering archiving of the document and its attachments with revocation of authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: The user who created the request for override.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments. Only the Business Admin group may create these.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations, distribution lists, and role-based access to documents in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the group's purpose (e.g. reader, author, reviewer, releaser, archive).

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Email address used for system notifications.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License role assigned to the user (e.g. AUTHOR, READER).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for distribution by email notification or for acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups and persons who receive email notification when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups and persons who must actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature recorded by a workflow participant during the release process, documented per released version for traceability.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The user who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step in the release process at which the signature was provided (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation record created when a user on the distribution list actively acknowledges receipt and review of a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: confirmed_by
attributes.description: The user who confirmed the acknowledgement.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the acknowledgement was confirmed.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (e.g. department, location, business area) that can be linked to documents and used for structuring and scoping.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the organizational unit.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and cross-referencing in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the business process.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents for governance and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the risk.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application master data object that can be referenced by documents via their properties.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the IT application.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational entity in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or hidden but not modified.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the client.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document that must go through its own review and release workflow before being visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language of the translated version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the language version (e.g. in translation, released).

o2o.description: Each document belongs to exactly one document type that determines its classification and configuration.
Each document type can have one or more document templates available for creating new documents.
An attachment is appended to and controlled by a main document.
Additional information is supplementary to a main document without affecting its version.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request selects a specific archived document for reactivation.
A document can be linked to organizational units for structuring and scoping.
A document can be linked to processes for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to risks for governance tracking.
A document can reference IT applications via its properties.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
A distribution list is maintained per document to define its distribution scope.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
Users are members of user groups which grant them specific authorizations.
A language version is a translation of a specific released document.
A document can be configured to be visible or hidden in specific clients.
